description:
Electrical schematic sheet 21 of 27 from project SWS_108-1 "Hydraulic System Automation", section AFT, drawing file SWS_108-1_AFT PLC.dwg, MYT-Systems S.r.l., rev 4, dated 05/05/2026. The sheet shows three WAGO 750-508 2-channel digital output (2DO) PLC modules (CPU 750-8213), each feeding two solenoid valve coils via a "Connector Type I" (cross-referenced as "see sheet 4"). 

Module 1 (POS.13, labeled DO-03): CH01 and CH02 outputs, each terminal pair marked "+" and "−" over a symbol resembling a solenoid coil, wired down to a 4-pin circular "Connector Type I" (pins 1,2,3,4). CH01 drives "transom door CLOSE (EV 10.1A)"; CH02 drives "transom door OPEN (EV 10.1B)".

Module 2 (POS.14, labeled DO-04): same structure, feeding "deck door OPEN (EV 10.2A)" on CH01 and "deck door CLOSE (EV 10.2B)" on CH02, via its own Connector Type I.

Module 3 (POS.15, labeled DO-05): feeding "mainsheet traveler TO PORT (EV 10.3A)" on CH01 and "mainsheet traveler TO STBD (EV 10.3B)" on CH02, via its own Connector Type I.

Each 2DO module block shows TYPE: 750-508, CPU: 750-8213, POS.: 13/14/15 respectively, with terminal markers A1/A2 (module supply/bus terminals), two round contact terminals per channel, then the DO channel output terminals (+/− polarity pairs) leading to ground/earth symbol terminals before reaching the circular 4-pin connector to the field solenoid valve coil (EV = electrovalve solenoid). No local switches, panel switches, or separate protective fuses/breakers are shown on this sheet for the individual valve circuits — control originates purely from the PLC digital outputs (DO-03/DO-04/DO-05, channels 1 and 2). No alarm/monitoring taps are indicated on this sheet. Title block gives drawing info: Job N°: --, Client: S.W. SHIPYARD, Project: SWS_108-1, Title: HYDRAULIC SYSTEM AUTOMATION, Section: AFT, Sheet 21 of 27, Rev 4, Date 05/05/2026. Revision history shows Rev 0 (21/03/2023, first issue) and Rev 4 (05/05/2026, "SUBSTITUTE WINCHES MODULES FROM DIGITAL TO ANALOG"). Left margin note: "Diritti riservati in osservanza della norma DIN 34" (rights reserved per DIN 34 standard).</description>
